title: Two movers calling at the same instants
description: Two whistle tracks call at nearly identical instants (3 s apart) from mirrored positions, converging near the centre at t=1900 s. Near-simultaneous events can never belong to one corridor (a few seconds with hundreds of metres between them is unreachable), and the mirror symmetry makes the post-convergence assignment a near-tie that must surface as tied competing candidates.

books.name: wetland-standard
